title: Unilab tops pharma category in PH’s Best Employers 2026
summary: Unilab, Inc., the country’s leading and most-trusted pharmaceutical company, ranked first in the Drugs and Biotechnology category and 28th overall in the Philippines’ Best Employers 2027 list…

blocks.text: Unilab, Inc., the country’s leading and most-trusted pharmaceutical company, ranked first in the Drugs and Biotechnology category and 28th overall in the Philippines’ Best Employers 2027 list compiled by the Philippine Daily Inquirer and international data and business intelligence firm Statista. The Campos-Hess-led pharma earned a score of 8.90, placing it among the leading organizations on a list recognizing 300 employers across private companies, government agencies and public institutions. The ranking was based on an independent online survey of more than 16,000 employees nationwide.
